title: Intel’s stock crashes, knocking $12B from government’s stake
script:
Intel just lost twelve billion dollars of government value.
Intel's client computing segment revenue recently declined by five percent.
The AI industry is gobbling up memory and high-bandwidth memory.
This AI demand is causing PC component prices to rise.
Intel warned its gross profit margin will drop to thirty-seven percent.
Intel now struggles to balance consumer hardware with massive AI chip needs.
Does this drop make you worry about your next PC purchase?
